title: Mussels with fennel and tomato
summary: Mussels with fennel and tomato is a italian dinner built around mussels and fennel, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Mussels with fennel and tomato. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add mussels and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and fennel.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Mussels with fennel and tomato before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Mussels with fennel and tomato.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
